additional_info.subject: from RC
additional_info.body: The station has turned off. The KF10 problem is back, the GQ2-3 fan problem is back, and the LED is not working properly. The station has recurring problems, the station wiring has been checked, everything looks fine. KF10 error was diagnosed and no fault was found - ID0388606 Fan error was also not found - both fans are new/replaced - ID0384100 LED - bad contact of the connection block. There is green, red. Blue color flashing yellow - ID0378723

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0408929-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / RN 170002799] multiple errors CRM:00579001523
additional_info.body:
Hi,
I would like to review the station again with your assistance so that we can check it from all aspects.
The KF10 errors kept popping up, but never shut down the station completely. We have 3 chargers at this location - it is the most important charging HUB in Warsaw.
The errors are recurring and can be seen in Sifinity at least this morning:
Photo 21.02 PM16.39 is the date and time when I arrived at the station - it was off.
The LED strip behaves differently:
- in the stadby state:
The videos show different behavior, depending on how I corrected the LED plug.
- Once in standby, it glows green,
- with the door open it turns red,
- when charging it flashes green or red,
- after “closing” the station, it does not immediately go white, but red.
The LED plug is also replaced, the one that goes directly into the XD38 block.
As for the fan:
- both fans are new, the errors are the same, is there a problem in the charger wiring?
BR Szymon

additional_info.body:
Hello Szymon,
After today's intervention we were able to fix de issue.
The exact location of the missing signal was not possible to determine but we know that was on XD7-1. Probably a bad connection between the resistor and the socket. In case this issue happen again, please replace those parts, socket and resistor.
I will now proceed to close this ticket.
Than you for your efforts today!
